constraints: No shared source/docs edits, no QEMU/build, no candidate or ledger promotions. Preserve all ten Kernel profiles and existing OS userland profiles.

gaps: Map every Issue 8 interface, utility and normative behavior; classify all mandatory/selected/unsupported options and runtime/header declarations.
Archive authenticated sources; enumerate syscall/error/flag/ELF/TLS/signal/structure layouts and golden fixtures per retained tuple.
Expand feature-family seeds to exact bits, revisions, read/write/replay/tool support and permitted/rejected combinations.
Pin RFC revisions/updates/errata and map each selected MUST/SHOULD to implementation/test ownership.

sdk20-native.scope: SDK20 privileged x86_64 six-layout provider guest; no user execution
sdk20-native.audit_depth: top-level status and bytes inspected; nested artifacts not rehashed by this audit

sdk20-linux.scope: Two x86_64 Linux readonly reference boots; no physical/SMP
sdk20-linux.audit_depth: top-level status and bytes inspected; nested artifacts not rehashed by this audit

sdk21-candidate.audit_depth: top-level status and bytes inspected; nested artifacts not rehashed by this audit

sdk21-commands.audit_depth: top-level status and bytes inspected; nested artifacts not rehashed by this audit

milestones.name: Specification baseline
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Standards/format/RFC inventories, syscall/ELF ABI matrix, SDK generations, feature ledger, dependency pins
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Every requirement has owner, semantics source, dependencies and a planned test; ten ABI profiles have explicit qualification gaps
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Versioned seed ledger, validation tooling, ten ABI tuples and explicit SDK identity validation exist. Four normative inventories are partial; the source ledger attaches zero execution receipts.

gates.expectation: Every requirement has an owner and semantics source
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Expand seed requirements to every Issue 8 clause/interface/utility/option, selected RFC MUST/SHOULD, exact ext4 format feature and permitted combination; preserve authoritative versions and ownership.

gates.expectation: Every requirement has dependencies and a planned acceptance test
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Create the missing normative rows and tests; mapping a subsystem summary to one test does not cover its constituent requirements.

gates.expectation: Ten ABI profiles have explicit qualification gaps
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Complete per-profile syscall/errno/flag/ELF/TLS/signal/struct inventories and authenticated source pin provenance. Existing bootstrap tuple tables remain valid subsets.

milestones.name: Resource foundation
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Kernel-owned allocators, general native VM, safe user copies, wait queues, timers, locking/atomics, FPU context
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Ten native guests run allocation/map/unmap/protection/pressure/timer tests without corrupting kernel or peers; document real hardware restrictions
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Actual bounded anonymous VM, eager fork, guarded copies, native process-frame ownership, calibrated clock/sleep/poll/select subsets execute. Bounded firmware-qualified pools and explicit fallbacks remain; object allocation and synchronized general waits are absent.

gates.expectation: Ten native guests execute allocation/map/unmap/protection/pressure tests
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Replace fixed per-process/global metadata limits with policy-backed object/frame allocation; qualify quotas/reclaim, pin/reference ownership and rollback using real physical frames on retained platforms.

gates.expectation: Timer/wait tests cannot corrupt kernel or peers
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Unify typed generation-safe completion, predicate registration and cancellation; add IRQ-safe save/restore locking, timer queue lifecycle, real thread waits and no lost wakeups. Current boot-CPU scanning is a narrower contract.

gates.expectation: Locking/atomics/FPU context and hardware restrictions are qualified
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Per-profile nested IRQ state, atomic widths/orders, FPU/SIMD isolation and save/restore need dedicated native evidence; document unavailable instruction/protection/platform features without dropping profiles.

milestones.name: Common OS objects
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Unified path resolution, symlinks, inode/dentry/mount references, file descriptions, credentials, AF_UNIX/descriptor passing, TTY
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Relative exec works from a renamed cwd; open/unlink/rename races preserve identity; PTY child and IPC peers terminate/wake correctly
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Shared object-based resolver, retained cwd/dirfd, symlinks, open descriptions, dup/fork sharing, pipes and partial credentials are implemented and have native subset tests. Native AF_UNIX rights and TTY/PTY lifecycle are not present.

gates.expectation: Relative exec works from a renamed cwd
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Retain this passing behavior while replacing fixed lifetimes; extend through mount cover/unmount and permission changes. This clause does not qualify all of M2.

gates.expectation: Open/unlink/rename races preserve identity
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Add synchronized mount/inode/dentry lifetime and concurrent namespace semantics; existing serialized identity checks do not establish races.

gates.expectation: PTY child and IPC peers terminate and wake correctly
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement TTY/PTY/termios plus signal-dependent lifecycle, AF_UNIX/socketpair, SCM_RIGHTS, peer credentials, close/exit wakeup and descriptor-reference ownership.

milestones.name: Libc substrate
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Per-arch Linux ABI adapter, threads/TLS/futex/signals, auxv and static musl
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Each architecture executes musl-linked file/process/thread/signal/clock tests; 32-bit time64/off64 and endian layouts pass golden vectors
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Static musl startup/single-thread TLS, files/processes/clock subsets execute on all ten historical qualified SDK20 profiles. Actual runtime selects threads()[0]; no general native clone threads, signals or futex substrate.

gates.expectation: Each architecture executes musl-linked file/process/thread/signal/clock tests
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement real thread selection/stacks/TLS/sharing, clone flag ordering, thread-group exec/exit, futex wait/wake/robust exit, signals/sigreturn/restart/cancellation, then execute actual pthread/signal workloads.

gates.expectation: 32-bit time64/off64 and endian layouts pass golden vectors and execution
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Existing bounded time/ABI codecs do not cover complete stat/TTY/signal/IPC structures; wide offsets remain restricted on 32-bit paths. Complete all required layouts and native negative cases.

gates.expectation: Auxv/static musl semantics include qualified startup entropy
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement source-qualified CSPRNG/readiness and startup entropy; exercise allocator/stdio/math/headers under defined FPU ABI and resource pressure, retaining native personality regressions.

milestones.name: Durable default root
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Canonical metadata buffers, block request/completion ownership, synchronous JBD2 replay/writer and modern ext4 core
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Linux-created image boots, mutates, power-fails, replays, and passes Linux/e2fsck checks; fsync claims tested through actual FLUSH ordering
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Real Virtio nonjournalled ext4 subset, narrow JBD2 recovery/metadata transactions, canonical bounded buffers and opt-in maintained timestamps exist. Readonly mounted namespace with internal metadata maintenance is not a general journalled root writer.

gates.expectation: Linux-created modern ext4 image boots and mutates
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Complete S1/S2 reader/group/checksum/64-bit/htree/extent and lifetime foundations; route ordinary namespace, allocation, extent, xattr/ACL and orphan mutations through one mounted transaction owner.

gates.expectation: Power-fail image replays and passes Linux/e2fsck
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Expand bounded whole-operation metadata fixtures to real mounted file/create/rename/unlink/truncate workloads, journal wrap/revoke/orphans and every commit/checkpoint interruption; maintain genuine failure-media captures.

gates.expectation: fsync ordering is verified through actual FLUSH
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Trace ordered data/journal commit/home checkpoint/clean publication and device flush under failures for the default writer; existing synchronous subset flush evidence cannot establish general crash consistency.

milestones.name: Useful POSIX userland
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Shared musl/loader, coherent file mappings/page cache, shell/job control/utilities, remaining file/time/IPC/locale semantics and ports framework
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Shared applications, dlopen/TLS, pthread cancellation, shell pipelines/redirection/jobs and designated POSIX suites execute in guests
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Small native shell/pipelines and static musl subset exist. Dynamic ELF admission is restricted and file/shared mappings, general pthread/signal semantics and conforming shell/job control remain open.

gates.expectation: Shared applications and dlopen/TLS execute
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement PT_INTERP/ET_DYN, file/private/shared mapping and coherent cache, architecture relocations, loader paths, TLS DSOs, constructors, RELRO and safe unload.

gates.expectation: pthread cancellation executes correctly
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Complete M3 signals/futex/thread lifecycle then public cancellation points, cleanup, robust/process-shared synchronization and loader/thread interaction.

gates.expectation: Shell pipelines/redirection/jobs execute with required utilities
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Port pinned shell and utility set after sessions/process groups/TTY/signals; implement required utilities, locale/text behavior and designated shell clauses.

gates.expectation: Designated POSIX suites execute in guests
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Select versioned suites and clause mapping, report unsupported options truthfully through headers/sysconf/pathconf/getconf; close mandatory deviations instead of passing stubs.

milestones.name: Connected host
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: IRQ-driven Virtio NICs, sockets/events, IPv4/IPv6 UDP/TCP and route configuration
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Guest-to-host and guest-to-guest applications run over actual NICs under loss/reordering; DNS and HTTP/TLS clients work without debug transport
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Loopback/debug network and device/service records are models. No observed real user socket to OS-owned NIC Internet host path qualifies this gate.

gates.expectation: Guest-host and guest-guest apps exchange actual NIC traffic
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement OS Virtio NIC transport with IRQ/DMA/completion ownership on all ten, canonical socket descriptors/events, Ethernet/ARP/IP/UDP/TCP and route control; verify independent capture/peer bytes.

gates.expectation: Loss/reordering and host protocol requirements pass
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement full TCP lifecycle/congestion/RTO/flow control, IPv6/ND/RA/DAD/PMTU/multicast/fragment behavior and hostile packet/pressure suites with real socket calls.

gates.expectation: DNS and HTTP/TLS clients work without debug transport
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Provide resolver configuration/DNS UDP+TCP, time and CSPRNG trust prerequisites, DHCP/IPv6 configuration and pinned client ports; debug channel or synthetic receive does not count.

milestones.name: Managed system
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: User PID 1, accounts, login/session, device, network, resolver, logging, time, mount and scheduler services
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Boot without test mode, crash/restart services, recover dependency failure, reap orphans, rotate logs and shut down/reboot with disk consistency
milestones.current_concrete_scope: /init launches acceptance or one shell and returns when it ends. Parent-zero kernel reaping/service models are not persistent user PID1 supervision.

gates.expectation: Normal boot runs persistent PID1 with dependency/readiness management
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Designate user PID1/reparenting/init-death semantics; implement foreground service manifests, authenticated per-launch readiness, generation-safe process control, privileges and resource limits.

gates.expectation: Crash/restart/dependency failures and orphan reaping recover
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement real signals/process control/wait-any/SIGCHLD, service restart bounds/backoff, orphan and zombie policy; execute failures on all ten.

gates.expectation: Required services/accounts/sessions and log rotation work
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement listed log/dev/network/resolver/time/storage/account/login/session/seat/job/update services with versioned credential-checked IPC and durable configs.

gates.expectation: Shutdown/reboot preserves consistency
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Stop sessions/units in reverse dependency order, TERM/KILL with deadlines, drain logs/I/O, sync/unmount and device quiesce; record sync failure honestly and retain rescue.

milestones.name: Isolated graphics
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Display/input descriptors, seat leases, Wayland, shared buffers, fonts, toolkit and PTY terminal
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Separate user compositor and two clients draw concurrently; killing one client cannot read peer buffers or stop input; kernel rescue survives
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Prelinked OS kernel extension draws desktop views; kernel buffer slots are not isolated shared mappings. Existing visual/model tests remain useful regression fixtures.

gates.expectation: Separate user compositor and two clients draw concurrently
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Provide display/input FDs, revocable seat leases and owned buffers; implement AF_UNIX rights/shared file mappings then pinned Wayland software compositor and two real client processes.

gates.expectation: Client kill cannot expose peer buffers or stop input
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Enforce page/FD/lease generations, buffer/presentation lifetimes, guarded truncated SHM access, protocol bounds and distinct credentials/address spaces; execute malicious client/death tests.

gates.expectation: Kernel rescue survives and text/PTY foundations work
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Keep boot/rescue diagnostics; add exclusive display owner transitions, scalable fonts/shaping/toolkit/input, PTY terminal, CJK/RTL and keyboard focus tests.

milestones.name: Daily desktop
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Files, editor, settings, tasks, logs, network, packages, installer/recovery and accessibility
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Scripted and human novice workflows pass: login, network, file copy/save/reopen, package install/rollback, lock and clean shutdown
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Existing attractive app views are in-kernel extension views. They do not qualify user login, durable documents, networking, installation or accessibility workflows.

gates.expectation: Novice login/network/file-copy/save/reopen workflows pass
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement independent Files/Editor/Settings/Tasks/Logs/Network/Terminal applications atop actual IPC, permissions, coherent files and durable root; supply error/loading/offline/full-disk states.

gates.expectation: Package install/rollback, lock and clean shutdown work
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Add trusted package metadata/verification, durable staged install/update/rollback and installer/recovery media; qualified accounts/seat lock/revoke and shutdown required.

gates.expectation: Accessibility/persistent preferences and human workflows qualify
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement keyboard-only navigation, UTF-8/CJK input, scaling and accessibility interfaces; execute scripted acceptance and record real human novice/screen-reader workflows.

milestones.name: Ext4 breadth
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Advanced features and qualified combinations from the ext4 matrix
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Every advertised read/write/replay profile round-trips with pinned Linux/e2fsprogs; unsupported combinations are explicitly rejected
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Explicit subset/modern metadata profiles reject unsupported combinations. Advanced feature requirements remain planned in the ledger.

gates.expectation: Every advertised read/write/replay profile round-trips with pinned references
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement and qualify S7 legacy mappings, larger blocks/inline/ea_inode/large directories, quota/project, external journals, fscrypt, verity, casefold, bigalloc, MMP, fast commit and online growth as selected by full feature matrix.

gates.expectation: Unsupported combinations are explicitly rejected
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Expand exact per-bit/version/read/write/replay/tool combination table and corruption tests; do not describe safe current rejection as implemented advanced functionality.

gates.expectation: Mixed profiles preserve recovery/resource/security semantics
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Exercise two-device failure, crypto/key/cache lifetime, Unicode policy, cluster allocation, simultaneous-mount fencing and fast/full commit crossover after their specific dependencies.

milestones.name: Execution breadth
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Real SMP and TLB shootdowns, loaded native modules, IRQ/DMA/hotplug, physical reference machines
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: Module code truly relocates/executes; no use-after-unload; concurrent filesystem/socket/GUI stress passes; hardware evidence is separate from QEMU
milestones.current_concrete_scope: SMP topology/lock records and prelinked module metadata are foundations/models. Current qualified runtime and maintained metadata are serialized on boot CPU.

gates.expectation: Native module relocates and executes new code
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement bounded immutable ET_REL capture, exact SDK/compiler validation, per-arch relocation, W^X/cache finalization, initialization/unwind and real exported service call.

gates.expectation: No use-after-unload with callbacks/IRQ/DMA/work
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Reference/pin module dependencies and active resources; stop publication, drain timers/work/IRQs/DMA and workers, reject EBUSY if not quiescent, then unmap; exercise repeated load/unload.

gates.expectation: Real SMP/TLB and concurrent filesystem/socket/GUI stress passes
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Implement secondary startup/IPI/per-CPU execution, complete thread scheduling, atomics/lock ranks, remote TLB retirement and concurrent ownership; hosted spinlocks/topology do not prove it.

gates.expectation: Physical reference machines have separate evidence
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Select explicit platform matrix and record actual boot/storage/NIC/display/input/IRQ/DMA/reset/hotplug behavior; QEMU evidence never substitutes for named machines.

milestones.name: Full target
milestones.deliverable_verbatim: Closed requirements ledger, release/debug qualification, reproducible artifacts, documentation and recovery media
milestones.exit_gate_verbatim: No mandatory or selected-profile gaps; ten architectures pass the applicable user ABI/product gates; scope and remaining outside-profile limitations are published
milestones.current_concrete_scope: Strict SDK producer/consumer pipeline and many preserved subset receipts exist. No complete normative ledger, ten-profile workstation qualification or recoverable product release exists.

gates.expectation: No mandatory/selected-profile gaps
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Close all exact inventories, code semantics and acceptance gates; preview waivers cannot mark M12 complete.

gates.expectation: Ten architectures pass applicable user ABI and product gates in Debug/Release
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Preserve ten profiles and existing qualified subsets while qualifying final exact sources/artifacts; physical platform selection is separate, and failed candidate matrices remain failed.

gates.expectation: Reproducible artifacts/documentation/recovery and published scope
gates.missing_mandatory_work: Produce matched reproducible SDK/sysroot/packages/install/recovery sets, update interruption evidence, release diagnostics and accurate capability/limitation table; repair stale docs and bind evidence to final source.

next_feature.scope: One generation-safe completion owner for existing boot-CPU pipe/sleep/readiness waits, with static-dispatch synchronization and native regression integration.
dependencies: Keep existing bounded page and descriptor pins; preallocate stable wait slots before blocking
Define one synchronization domain and lock order before registering callbacks
Preserve existing native/Linux pending-call copies and deadline semantics
New exported C++ layouts require next exact SDK generation and producer/consumer qualification
interfaces: WaitOutcome { ready, timeout, interrupted, canceled, source_closed }
invariants: No raw TCB/FD-slot pointer survives scheduler compaction or blocking
All resources admitted before registration publication
Condition mutation and subscription use the same synchronization domain
First valid completion owns the terminal outcome; stale generation cannot claim
No user copy, allocation, I/O, sleep or destructor callback while holding wait/source locks
Completion copyout revalidates current address space; exit cancellation never copies out
Pins released once after every source membership and timer reference is removed
Generation exhaustion rejects new admission rather than wrapping
acceptance: Deterministic hosted interleaving tests at predicate/registration/park/wake/timeout/cancel boundaries
ASan/UBSan and all-ten freestanding xmake compile
Actual native and musl pipe/sleep/poll/select guests preserving copied request and realtime-independent deadlines
Close/reuse/dup/fork/exit registration lifetime and exactly-once counters via independent receipts
Standalone Kernel plus SDK-only OS producer/consumer Debug/Release all-ten regression
explicit_nonclaims: No SMP/physical/IRQ-worker qualification from boot-CPU integration
No complete M1 or M3 claim
